description: This file defines utility functions for the Git::SVN Perl module, providing path/canonicalization, URL handling, feature detection, and error reporting functions.

methods.name: fatal
methods.description: Prints an error message to STDERR and exits with code 1.

methods.name: can_compress
methods.description: Checks if the Compress::Zlib module is available for use.

methods.name: canonicalize_path
methods.description: Converts a file path to its canonical form for SVN operations, using SVN API if available.

methods.name: canonicalize_url
methods.description: Converts a URL to its canonical form for SVN operations, using SVN API if available.

methods.name: join_paths
methods.description: Concatenates multiple paths into one, handling slashes appropriately.

methods.name: add_path_to_url
methods.description: Appends a path segment to a URL, ensuring proper slash handling and URI escaping.
